users.description: User profiles and RBAC role assignments across Ets AMANI.

agentFundStocks.description: Recalculable per-agent, per-currency dual-stock projections (physicalCash vs virtualCredit). Direct agent mutation prohibited; updated via validated transactions/allocations.

financialLedger.description: Append-only immutable accounting ledger separating USD and CDF.

financialTransactions.description: Agent-declared financial transactions (deposits, withdrawals, virtual transfers, FX, fees) with SMS reconciliation tracking.

replenishmentRequests.description: Agent requests for virtual credit or physical cash replenishment approved or rejected by DG or explicitly delegated agency admin.

cashHandovers.description: Bilateral cash receipts and handovers requiring two-party confirmation.

reconciliationRecords.description: Automatic and manual reconciliation matches between Mobile Money SMS operations and declared financial transactions.

financialAnomalies.description: Append-only financial anomalies and justification workflow; deletion strictly prohibited.

physicalInventories.description: Scheduled and unannounced physical cash and virtual channel inventory controls.

financialDelegations.description: Explicit, time-bounded, limit-capped credit approval delegations from DG to Administrateur d'Agence.

smsOperations.description: Mobile Money operator SMS captured automatically from collector SIM devices (preserved independent source).
